headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to better coordinate their programs that serve young people.
what_it_does: This 2008 order focuses on how federal agencies run and coordinate programs for youth. Based on its title, it aims to make these programs work together better and get better results. No summary was provided, so specific requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that run youth programs
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to coordinate their youth programs more closely with one another.

who_it_affects.group: Young people served by federal programs
who_it_affects.how: The programs they use may be organized or coordinated differently as a result of the order.
